name: Pearl Diving
summary: In the Badlands, Rigglefuzz is running low on powder for his flash bombs. He sends you to the Vile Reef in Stranglethorn to gather more.

sections.title: A Tricky Little Goblin
sections.body: Rigglefuzz admits the Badlands frighten him. A short little goblin, he faces predators and scavengers all around. He knows how to make flash bombs, and uses them to drive the wildlife away. Now he is running low on crushed blue pearl powder.

sections.title: Pearls from the Reef
sections.body: Clams at the Vile Reef in Stranglethorn hold blue pearls. Rigglefuzz jokes that you had better wear good boots, then waits in the Badlands for nine pearls. He promises to make your effort worthwhile.

faq.q: Why does Rigglefuzz need blue pearls?
faq.answer: Rigglefuzz uses crushed blue pearl powder to make flash bombs, and his supply is running low.

faq.q: Where are the blue pearls found?
faq.answer: Blue pearls are found in clams at the Vile Reef in Stranglethorn.

faq.q: Why does Rigglefuzz use flash bombs?
faq.answer: Vicious predators and bold scavengers fill the Badlands, so Rigglefuzz uses flash bombs to frighten the wildlife away.

faq.q: How many blue pearls does Rigglefuzz want?
faq.answer: Rigglefuzz wants you to bring him nine blue pearls in the Badlands.

angles.text: As an engineer, you have good reason to take an interest in Rigglefuzz's flash bombs.
